stories.title: Leading the Way
stories.detail: Ray Carroll leading on 22 pts - the ladder doesn't lie, except about Fremantle apparently

stories.title: In the Hunt
stories.detail: 2nd - level with the lead with 6 to play

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Welcome to Wagga Wagga Country Club, Benedict Aungles - great to have The SGA GC with us today. Enjoy your round.

stories.title: Rock Solid
stories.detail: Zero wipes and 7 two-pointers - boring in the best way

stories.title: Reachable Feeling
stories.detail: 2 of the par 5s gave up 3-pointers - length is a weapon

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: Short-Hole Assassin
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 3s - the short holes never stood a chance

stories.title: The Complete Package
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s AND 3s - a round that covers all four food groups

stories.title: The Metronome
stories.detail: 6 holes in a row at 2 points or better - tick, tick, tick

stories.title: The Golf Tax
stories.detail: One good hole then one bad on holes 16 & 17 - the course charges a fee for everything

stories.title: One-Trick Pony (Technically Solid)
stories.detail: 5 1-pointers - found a formula and sticking to it

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 3 twos on holes 12, 13 & 14 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: The Full Experience
stories.detail: Hit every outcome on the card - the golf round as a show bag

stories.title: Finding a Rhythm
stories.detail: 3 twos on the bounce on holes 12, 13 & 14

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 3 twos in a row on holes 10, 11 & 12 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: Perfectly Mediocre
stories.detail: 3 1-pointers straight - one point at a time, every time
